objects.name: Analytic 2196
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies network device credential changes such as Authentication, Authorization, and Accounting (AAA) password modification or Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) community string modification from a source not in the approved Network Management System (NMS) Classless Inter-Domain Routing (CIDR) subnet, corroborated by syslog showing authentication failures from legitimate NMS systems following the change. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: networkdevice:syslog
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: AAA/Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) credential change from source not in approved Network Management System (NMS) Classless Inter-Domain Routing (CIDR) subnet, followed by authentication failures from legitimate NMS systems

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Accounts authorized to change credentials for ICS service and operator accounts.
Time window after a credential change within which a service authentication failure is considered directly connected.
Documented schedule for routine credential rotation.
